cases.name: if_fn
cases.sql: SELECT if(true, 'a', 'b'), if(false, 1), if(CAST(NULL AS boolean), 1, 2), if(1 > 0, 1.5E0, 2)

cases.name: if_lazy
cases.sql: SELECT if(x = 0, NULL, 10 / x) FROM (VALUES 0, 5) t(x) ORDER BY x

cases.name: case_count_filter
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE x > 1), count_if(x > 1), sum(x) FILTER (WHERE x < 3) FROM (VALUES 1, 2, 3) t(x)

cases.name: typeof_fn
cases.sql: SELECT typeof(CAST(1 AS bigint)), typeof(1E0), typeof(DATE '2024-01-01'), typeof(X'00'), typeof(true)

cases.name: try_cast_fn
cases.sql: SELECT TRY_CAST('x' AS integer), TRY_CAST('12' AS integer), TRY_CAST(NULL AS integer)

cases.name: try_fn
cases.sql: SELECT try(1 / 0), try(CAST('x' AS integer)), try(5), try(CAST(NULL AS integer))

cases.name: try_per_row
cases.sql: SELECT x, try(10 / x) FROM (VALUES 0, 2, 5) t(x) ORDER BY x

cases.name: try_function_errors
cases.sql: SELECT try(from_hex('zz')), try(date_add('hour', 1, DATE '2024-01-01')), try(abs(CAST(-9223372036854775808 AS bigint))), try(json_parse('{'))

cases.name: try_coalesce
cases.sql: SELECT coalesce(try(CAST(s AS bigint)), -1) FROM (VALUES '12', '12x', NULL) t(s) ORDER BY 1

cases.name: try_in_where
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES '1', 'x', '3') t(s) WHERE try(CAST(s AS integer)) > 0

cases.name: typeof_more
cases.sql: SELECT typeof(ARRAY[1]), typeof(MAP(ARRAY[1], ARRAY[1.5E0])), typeof(DECIMAL '1.50'), typeof(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00.123456'), typeof(CAST(NULL AS varchar)), typeof(NULL), typeof(ROW(1, 2.5E0)), typeof(CAST(NULL AS timestamp(3) with time zone))

cases.name: coalesce_types
cases.sql: SELECT coalesce(NULL, 1, 2), coalesce(CAST(NULL AS varchar), NULL), typeof(coalesce(1, 2.5E0)), nullif(CAST(NULL AS bigint), 1), nullif('a', 'a')

cases.name: case_simple_types
cases.sql: SELECT CASE 2 WHEN 1 THEN 'a' WHEN 2 THEN 'b' END, CASE WHEN false THEN 1 END, typeof(CASE WHEN true THEN 1 ELSE 2.5E0 END)

cases.name: uuid_fn
cases.sql: SELECT length(CAST(uuid() AS varchar)), regexp_like(CAST(uuid() AS varchar), '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'), CAST(uuid() AS varchar) <> CAST(uuid() AS varchar)

cases.name: uuid_per_row
cases.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT CAST(uuid() AS varchar)), count(*) FROM (VALUES 1, 2, 3) t(x)

cases.name: uuid_cast_varchar_csf
cases.sql: SELECT typeof(CAST(uuid() AS varchar)), CAST(uuid() AS varchar) IS NOT NULL

cases.name: typeof_scalars
cases.sql: SELECT typeof(1), typeof(CAST(1 AS tinyint)), typeof(1.5), typeof(1.5E0), typeof(CAST('a' AS varchar)), typeof(DATE '2024-01-01')
